steps.content: Having set the trap, you wait for it to walk into it.
You check your watch. It's been half an hour since you stopped chasing it. It must have grown bored and impatient.
You sit back on the bench, making a great show of being exhausted.

steps.speaker: Black Shadow
steps.content: Hey... are you giving up?
You feel a tap on your right shoulder. It is walking into your trap.
It's voice lost that brightness from earlier. No longer sound excited. It sounds like a sad kid who has no friend to play with.

steps.speaker: Black Shadow
steps.content: It took me so long... to finally find someone who is willing to play with me...

steps.speaker: Black Shadow
steps.content: You haven't come to me for a long time... Was it because I was going too fast? I promise I can slow down a bit this time...
The shadow figure inches toward you while saying words of encouragement.

steps.speaker: Black Shadow
steps.content: Ah! So you were just pretending! You weren't really tired. I can't believe you played dirty again!

steps.speaker: Black Shadow
steps.content: Is that what you wanted to hear? Hehe, that's too bad.
You lunge at it. Another failed attempt...

steps.speaker: Black Shadow
steps.content: No one at home can ever catch me! So, maybe you should just give up!
It's leaning against the wall, gloating over your failure.
The real opportunity to catch it has finally presented itself.
With great effort, you make another lunge for it.

steps.speaker: Black Shadow
steps.content: Hehe, I told you it won't work...
It talks and moves back at the same time, it passes through the wall and unknowingly walks into your trap.
You've successfully carried out your plan. Now all you have to do is wait and see if the trap will work.

steps.speaker: Black Shadow
steps.content: Ahhhhhhhh!
A sharp cry comes from the other side of the wall.
Looks like the trap is working. You rush over to the other side, ready to reap the reward.
